summary: Provision ModelSight monitoring trial: 40 GPU-enabled agent seats, SCIM/Okta, BYOK KMS evaluation
description: Request to procure and onboard ModelSight (model-monitoring vendor) for a pilot spanning Research and Platform. Team requests an enterprise trial with 40 GPU-enabled agent seats, SCIM provisioning via Okta, and evaluation of BYOK KMS integration for audit-sensitive telemetry. This ticket coordinates procurement, security review, SSO/SCIM configuration, and billing setup.
impact: Research and Platform teams cannot start the scheduled model-run monitoring pilot (target week of 2026-03-22) until seats and SSO are configured. Delay will push the evaluation and cost/quality signals used for Dedicated capacity planning.
request_details:
- Vendor: ModelSight (sales@modelsight.dev)
- SKU: Enterprise Trial (server-side agent + GPU inference telemetry)
- Quantity: 40 concurrent agent seats (mix of ephemeral research VMs + 4 long-running infra agents)
- Duration: 30-day trial with option to convert to annual contract
- Integrations: Okta SCIM provisioning, SAML SSO, BYOK KMS (customer-managed key) for telemetry at rest
- Compliance ask: SOC2 docs, data residency statement (US), and contract data processing addendum (DPA)
cost_estimate: $6,400 for trial (vendor quoted $160/seat for trial window), estimated annual run-rate $57,600 if converted to enterprise

2026-03-11 Maya Thompson (Finance): Budget owner approves trial spend up to $7k. Finance needs vendor W-9 and procurement form to process payment.

2026-03-12 Ethan Rivera (Assignee): I'll kick off SCIM setup with Okta once vendor provides a test SCIM endpoint and SAML metadata. Also added infra checklist to PR and scheduled a 30-min handoff with Research on 2026-03-15.
2026-03-12 Priya Shah: Added billing code and Confluence link. Vendor requested payment method and PoC start date; we've proposed 2026-03-22 as pilot start. Pending security and legal signoff.
resolution: Pending security and legal signoff; no provisioning performed yet
